comparison.objective: Set a grinder tool rest and tongue guard to safe gaps, clamp the rest, then start the grinder.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine linear gap adjustment, quarter-turn cam locking, bimanual guard positioning, and safe button actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Rest gap at most 3 mm and tongue gap at most 6 mm without contact; rest clamped at least 80 degrees; START only after safe setup; hands clear of the turning wheel.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest record because both adjust, lock, and actuate machinery. However, it tests static spatial clearances and a cam clamp; the candidate tests a recessed hex setscrew, collar tuning, and repeated energy-dependent stopping without bottoming or rebound. Candidate rubric still lacks numeric thresholds for excessive rebound, overload, and the declared collar-drift tolerance, but those omissions do not erase the different tested mechanism and outcome.
